### Light That Travels
Author: Jennifer Waddle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-october-21.html
Passage: Matthew 4:16
Points:
- Just as natural light travels vast distances to reach dark places, Christ entered the world as true light for humanity.
- Many people remain trapped in spiritual darkness because they look away from God's offered truth.
- Believers are responsible for reflecting Christ's life-giving light within their homes, workplaces, and communities.
- Followers of Jesus must step out of comfort zones and shine His hope into a hurting world.

### Don’t Play with Fire
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/dont-play-with-fire
Passage: Matthew 4:17
Points:
- Even respected and faithful believers remain susceptible to the pulls of their fallen nature.
- Yielding to temptation always brings painful consequences that harm both ourselves and those around us.
- Wisdom requires actively steering clear of compromising environments rather than trusting our own willpower.
- Christ's call to repent urges believers to abandon hidden compromise and return to God for cleansing and restoration.
